from datetime import datetime, timezone

from .errors import BillingError


def utcnow() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc)


def ensure_utc(dt: datetime) -> datetime:
    if not isinstance(dt, datetime):
        raise BillingError("invalid_datetime", repr(dt))
    if dt.tzinfo is None or dt.utcoffset() is None:
        raise BillingError("naive_datetime", dt.isoformat())
    return dt.astimezone(timezone.utc)
=== MONEY ===
from decimal import ROUND_HALF_EVEN, Decimal, InvalidOperation

from .errors import BillingError

CENT = Decimal("0.01")
ZERO = Decimal("0.00")


def to_money(value) -> Decimal:
    """Convert an int, str or Decimal into a Decimal amount."""
    if isinstance(value, (bool, float)):
        raise BillingError("float_amount", f"refusing to convert {value!r}")
    if isinstance(value, Decimal):
        return value
    try:
        return Decimal(str(value))
    except InvalidOperation:
        raise BillingError("invalid_amount", repr(value)) from None


def round_money(value) -> Decimal:
    """Round to the cent using the finance team's rounding policy."""
    return to_money(value).quantize(CENT, rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)

from ledgerly.adjustments import outage_refund
from ledgerly.models import Payment
from ledgerly.errors import BillingError

T0 = datetime(2026, 10, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
p = Payment("p", "i", Decimal("80.00"), status="captured", created_at=T0, captured_at=T0)
outage_refund(p, Decimal("30.00"), T0)
assert p.refunded_amount == Decimal("30.00") and p.status == "captured"
outage_refund(p, Decimal("50.00"), T0)
assert p.refunded_amount == Decimal("80.00") and p.status == "refunded"

for amt, status in [(Decimal("0"), "captured"), (Decimal("-1"), "captured"), (Decimal("1"), "authorized")]:
    q = Payment("q", "i", Decimal("80.00"), status=status)
    try:
        outage_refund(q, amt, T0)
        raise AssertionError("should fail")
    except BillingError as e:
        print("ok", e.code)

q = Payment("q", "i", Decimal("80.00"), status="captured")
try:
    outage_refund(q, Decimal("80.01"), T0)
    raise AssertionError("should fail")
except BillingError as e:
    print("ok", e.code)
print("all edge cases pass")
EOF
